1120.name: Frozen Temple
1120.notes: An ancient temple to a forgotten frost god. Ice has claimed most of its halls.

1236.name: Frostbitten Camp
1236.notes: A hardy band of northern bandits who prey on fur traders. They've adapted to the frozen wastes.

1265.name: Rotherhine
1265.notes: A prosperous trade town on the eastern plains. Known for its horse markets.

1318.name: Snowbound Outpost
1318.notes: Bandits who raid the northern trade routes. Their camp is hidden among the snow drifts.

1437.name: Frost Goblin Warren
1437.notes: Ice goblins have dug into the frozen earth. They emerge at night to raid nearby settlements.

1497.name: Ruined Temple
1497.notes: Ancient temple ruins where dark cultists perform forbidden rituals.

1502.name: Bandit Camp
1502.notes: A rough camp of brigands hidden in the northern forest. They prey on travelers.

1560.name: Northern Sanctum
1560.notes: Crumbling ruins where cultists once gathered. Dark rituals still echo in the stones.

1570.name: Ruined Temple
1570.notes: A crumbling temple overtaken by a sinister cult.

1698.name: Forest Goblin Tribe
1698.notes: A large goblin tribe has claimed this section of forest. They breed wolves for war.

1710.name: Highwayman's Rest
1710.notes: Bandits who ambush merchants traveling to Falkenhaften. Well-organized and dangerous.

1755.name: Willow Dale Ruins
1755.notes: Crumbling stone ruins deep in the foothills.

1825.name: Bandit Hideout
1825.notes: A fortified cave entrance crawling with bandits.

1840.name: King's Watch
1840.notes: An ancient fortress guarding the approach to Falkenhaften. Now in ruins after the mountain pass collapsed.

1898.name: Hillside Goblin Den
1898.notes: Goblins have infested the eastern hills, raiding farms and caravans.

1942.name: Dalhurst
1942.notes: A quiet settlement on the western road.

1947.name: Ruined Crossroads
1947.notes: Cultists have defiled this once-peaceful crossroads with dark rituals.

1955.name: Thornfield
1955.notes: The easternmost town in the valley.

2042.name: Corsair Island
2042.notes: A lawless island where pirates rest between raids. Danger awaits the unwary.

2073.name: Ruined Temple
2073.notes: Overgrown temple ruins where cultists gather in secret.

2080.name: Elder Moor
2080.notes: Rolling moorland dotted with standing stones. Your journey begins here.

2092.name: Overgrown Shrine
2092.notes: A temple swallowed by the forest. Cultists have recently returned to its altars.

2134.name: Goblin Camp
2134.notes: A goblin warband has established a foothold in the western forest.

2141.name: Ruined Temple
2141.notes: A forgotten temple deep in the forest, now claimed by dark worshippers.

2148.name: Bandit Outpost
2148.notes: An eastern outpost where bandits watch the road to Thornfield.

2327.name: Sunken Crypts
2327.notes: A waterlogged burial ground slowly sinking into the marsh.

2329.name: Millbrook
2329.notes: A rickety little town clinging to the lakeshore.

2337.name: Vine-Choked Ruins
2337.notes: Nature has reclaimed this temple, but something still lurks in its depths.

2399.name: Bandit Encampment
2399.notes: A southern bandit camp that raids the road to Millbrook.

2402.name: Wyvern's Roost
2402.notes: A rocky outcropping where wyverns nest. Their shrieks echo across the hills.

2458.name: Mire Goblin Nest
2458.notes: Goblins thrive in the fetid swamp, using the murky waters to ambush prey.

2519.name: Goblin Camp
2519.notes: A crude goblin encampment in the southwestern wilderness. Their scouts watch the roads.

2523.name: Road to Kazer-Dun
2523.notes: The mountain road leading up to the great dwarf hold of Kazer-Dun.

2542.name: Pola Perron
2542.notes: A mountain town at the base of the eastern pass. Cut off from the capital by the collapse.

2651.name: Kazer-Dun Entrance
2651.notes: The great northern gate of Kazer-Dun Dwarf Hold.

2653.name: Ruined Temple
2653.notes: Dark rituals echo through these forsaken ruins.

2724.name: Keerzhar Bridge
2724.notes: A massive dwarf-built bridge spanning a deep canyon. The only crossing to the southern territories.

2748.name: Smuggler's Cove
2748.notes: A hidden cove where smugglers cache their goods. Pirates use it as a waypoint.

2794.name: Whaler's Abyss
2794.notes: A canyon town built on bridges spanning a deep chasm. Whalers hunt the great beasts of the eastern seas.

2914.name: Duncaster
2914.notes: A snowy mountain village nestled in the eastern peaks. Hardy folk mine the frozen slopes.

3012.name: Silvanost
3012.notes: The ancient elven city on the western coast. Few humans are welcomed within its silver gates.

3024.name: Pirate Stronghold
3024.notes: A fortified island base where the ghost pirate captain commands his undead fleet.

3031.name: Larton
3031.notes: A starving port town at the southern tip of the bay. Ghost pirates block all sea trade.

3090.name: Sea God's Shrine
3090.notes: An island temple once dedicated to the sea god. Now home to dark creatures.

3112.name: Sunken Shrine
3112.notes: A temple slowly sinking into the bog. Strange lights flicker within at night.

3292.name: Marsh Marauders
3292.notes: Desperate outlaws hiding in the swamp. They've made dark pacts to survive.

3613.name: Desert Goblin Burrow
3613.notes: Goblins adapted to desert life. They raid at dusk when the heat fades.

3684.name: Border Wars Graveyard
3684.notes: A valley cemetery where soldiers from ancient border conflicts were buried. The dead do not rest easy.

3688.name: Sand Raider Camp
3688.notes: Desert bandits who strike from the dunes. They know the wasteland's secrets.

3758.name: East Hollow
3758.notes: A dusty frontier settlement where humans and Tregar hybrids maintain an uneasy coexistence.

3806.name: Tenger Ancestral Ruins
3806.notes: Ancient Tenger burial grounds. The nomads say spirits still walk here.

3875.name: Oasis Hideout
3875.notes: Bandits control a small oasis, demanding tribute from travelers.

3908.name: Bloodsand Arena
3908.notes: A gladiatorial arena where warriors test their mettle in bloody combat.

3936.name: Tenger Camp
3936.notes: A nomadic desert encampment of the fierce Tenger people. Outsiders are viewed with suspicion.

4005.name: Sand-Buried Temple
4005.notes: Half-buried by centuries of sand, this temple still draws dark worshippers.

954.name: Falkenhaften
954.notes: The grand capital of the realm. The King has been absent for 40 years, and political intrigue fills the court.
